More than half of the year is over, but there are still a lot of stuff to be released. Share some of the releases you're waiting for that are probably coming out this year.

For me it would be,

Cruciamentum - Charnel Passages - I'm sure this band will deliver, this UK DM band has captured a lot of attention with their previous demo and EP.

Bolzer - Full Length - The hype is real for this one, with just one demo and two EP's this band has gained universal praise in the underground scene. Let's see if they'll deliver.

Deathhammer - Evil Power - Great Thrash Metal band from Norway. They make Thrash the way it's supposed to be, chaotic and primitive. Third albums drops soon.

Orchid - Sign of the Witch - US Doom Metal, bunch of EP's and two solid LP's. New EP is dropping soon.

Rotting Christ - New LP - Not really an underground band anymore. Most of you probably know these Greek maniacs, I'm always interested in their new releases since they progress from record to record in a natural and unique way, still keeping it real.

Iron Maiden - The Book of Souls - Well, who doesn't love Maiden? I'm not expecting a lot, but Maidens albums are always worth a listen.

Grave Miasma and Destroyer 666 have new material coming out soon too, but the D666 one may run into 2016.
